comparison.formal_similarity: strong Tſchiper- ~ Chiper- after established historical-modern affricate/orthographic comparison, but full phonological correspondence remains to be adjudicated
comparison.semantic_similarity: strong: historical thin/flat, SRC-02 flat, community context board-like/tabilla
comparison.modern_source_category_support: SRC-02 directly classifies Chipérami as Pp

strengths: Historical Tſchiperameke includes Flach ‘flat’ among its glosses.
SRC-02 Chipérami means ‘Plano’ and is directly classified Pp.
A 2010 SEP community riddle from El Tabacote, Guerrero uses chiperami in the Rarámuri line corresponding contextually to Spanish ‘tablilla’.
The modern form is therefore no longer confined to SRC-02/Hilton-lineage evidence.
remaining_problems: The community text gives contextual rather than isolated lexical equivalence; do not gloss chiperami solely as ‘plano’ from this source.
Establish the exact historical root and full sound correspondence Tſchiper- ~ Chiper- with independent series.
Determine whether the community form and SRC-02 Chipérami represent the same lexical/morphological item across varieties.
Do not transfer SRC-02 Pp classification to the community text.
